review.finding: New pure barrier validator requires the current original hold/request/operator/authVersion, enabled/unpaused policy/pin and stored pause/resume revision; it does not recover a historical ACK or mutate the hold.

Quiescence uses the existing Beta serial queue, captures Beta ledger and barrier before the bounded original-native RPC, validates native actor/policy/boolean/nonnegative counts and physicalProof=false, then rechecks current controls/barrier and Beta ledger. True requires both Beta snapshots and native proof to be quiet. Malformed/missing/native unknown or pause/control drift cannot return positive.

Independent operator GET has exact original requestId, no other query/method; current principal determines actor. Valid false proof remains visible with409; true gets200; no begin/end/pause/start capability is added.

Reviewed source cases cover real Workerd SQLite positive/negative/idle/partial/missing/unknown proof, foreign hold/actor/authVersion, pause during held native RPC, inert tables/KV/alarms, no native RPC from old receipt GET, strict current-operator HTTP boundary and409/200 preservation.

boundaries: This is logical original-ledger quiet proof while a barrier remains held, not physical Cloudflare instance release or rollout proof.
Cross-DO read is not a global writer lock; caller must freeze/recheck deployments/config and all other writer gates.
Unknown retains original hold/request for read-only recovery. No timer or historic ACK can reopen or clear another hold.
The prior first review remains historical and this receipt binds the c669 increment explicitly.
